findings.title: OpenAI-family streams never request usage, so usage is often absent
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec deliberately leaves the request payload unchanged (an unknown stream_options field can 400 on some servers). OpenRouter, which serves the evidence backends, reports usage unasked. usage is supporting evidence; finish_reason and reasoning_len are primary. 843ddef2 adds a comment: usage none means unreported, not zero.

findings.title: Reasoning double-counted when a frame carries both delta and message
findings.disposition_rationale: 843ddef2 takes the max of delta and message per frame, with a test.

findings.title: content_len is UTF-16 code units while byte_length is bytes
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec chose String.length for both lengths (reasoning has no byte form here); FAFF-1247 tallies on finish_reason and compares content_len to 0, where the units agree.

findings.title: The usage cap could crowd out reasoning_tokens
findings.disposition_rationale: 843ddef2 extracts reasoning_tokens before the scan, with a test at 20 keys.

findings.title: Completion lengths rendered unchecked could split a log line
findings.disposition_rationale: bfa3a8a2 renders lengths through safeLen (non-negative integer, else 0), with a test.
